title: 第11章  爆打杂役峰长老
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
“叶长天，敢杀我父亲的火云鸟，你死定了！”
宋浩狰狞一笑。
火云鸟可是父亲的心头肉，父亲对火云鸟甚至比他这个亲儿子还要宝贝。
他倒要看看，叶长天如何承受得了父亲的怒火。
就在宋浩刚要准备去通知父亲的时候，一道气息强大的人影咻地化作一道残影暴掠而来，咻地出现在了叶长天的面前。
来人正是宋浩的父亲、杂役峰长老宋元德。
宋元德在火云鸟身上留下了神识印记。
在火云鸟出事的那一刻，宋元德自然第一时间就感应到了。
看着火云鸟被分解的尸体，以及将火云鸟腿烤得滋滋冒油的叶长天，一股滔天的杀意瞬间从宋元德身上弥漫开来。
“小杂种，敢动本长老的火云鸟，你……该死！”
宋元德修炼天赋一般，只是下品火灵根。
他在太玄宗修炼了一辈子，好不容易修炼到炼气九层巅峰，然后就一直卡在炼气九层巅峰很多年，迟迟难以筑基。
宋元德之所以如此宝贝这只火云鸟，就是因为火云鸟的内丹，对他突破筑基有着至关重要的作用。
若是用火云鸟内丹再配合上筑基丹，绝对能让他筑基成功的概率提升十倍！
宋元德本来打算将火云鸟养到炼气九层再冲击筑基境。
到时候。
他吞服火云鸟内丹才能发挥出最大的作用。
却没想到。
眼前这小子竟然将他费尽心思培养的火云鸟给宰了！
这让宋元德如何能不怒？

面对杀意滔天的宋元德，叶长天神色却是没有丝毫变化。
他从容不迫地拿起烤好的鸟腿咬了一口，这才对着宋元德咧了咧嘴：
“宋长老，我来喂养火云鸟的时候它发狂了，刚才正当防卫的时候一不小心将它宰了，你应该不会介意吧？”
“这火云鸟肉质不错，要不要一起尝尝？”
宋元德面色铁青。
这小子不仅杀了火云鸟，还当着他的面把火云鸟给烤了！
简直没把他这个杂役峰长老放在眼里啊。
“宋浩，这究竟怎么回事？”
宋元德强压下心头的杀意，目光不由朝身后的宋浩望了过去。
“爸，叶长天是今天前来喂养火云鸟的杂役弟子，我也没想到他竟然将您的火云鸟害死了！”
宋浩连忙添油加醋地将事情说了一遍。
“……”
听得宋浩的话，宋元德甚至都有些怀疑自己耳朵是不是出现问题了！
这个杀了火云鸟的家伙，竟然是来喂养火云鸟的杂役弟子？
要知道。
他的火云鸟可是有着炼气七层的实力啊。
而杂役峰的杂役弟子，都是一些修为不到炼气三层的废物，怎么可能杀得了火云鸟？
难道——
这小子给火云鸟下毒了？
谁给他的胆子？

不管如何。
这小子杀了火云鸟，就等于断他修行之路。
此等仇怨，简直比杀父之仇还要不共戴天！
“小子，我不管你是谁，把火云鸟内丹交出来，本长老可以考虑留你一条全尸！”
宋元德目光冰冷地盯着叶长天，一字一句地说道。
炼气七层的火云鸟内丹对他突破筑基境，虽然不如炼气九层的火云鸟内丹有帮助，但也总比没有强。
“什么火云鸟内丹，我没看到。”
叶长天津津有味地啃着鸟腿，嘴里含糊不清地说道。
“找死！”
宋元德一声怒喝，身形一闪就出现在叶长天的面前，手掌快若闪电地对着叶长天的咽喉抓去。
叶长天右手拿着鸟腿，左手不慌不忙地伸出。
两根手指不偏不倚地夹住了宋元德的手掌，犹如夹住一片叶子一般轻描淡写。
“你……”
宋元德神色瞬间变得惊恐欲绝。
他可是炼气九层巅峰的修为，距离突破筑基都仅有一步之遥。
而眼前这小子只是轻描淡写地伸出两根手指，就将他禁锢住了，让他根本难以动弹分毫。
筑基境！
绝对是筑基境的修为！
这一刻。
宋元德方才明白，叶长天根本不是毒杀了他的火云鸟，而是真的有实力将火云鸟击杀啊。

“艹！”
“这小子不是杂役峰的杂役弟子么，怎么可能拥有筑基境的修为？”
宋元德又惊又怒。
他此刻杀了宋浩的心思都有了。
以他对宋浩的了解，这叶长天十有八九应该得罪了宋浩，才被宋浩安排来喂养发狂的火云鸟，利用火云鸟来解决叶长天。
这样的手段，宋浩早就用过不止一次了。
宋元德对于这事，一直都是睁一只眼闭一只眼。
这些杂役弟子成为火云鸟的血食，也能更快地将火云鸟培养到炼气九层。
更何况——
杂役弟子在太玄宗就跟奴隶没什么分别，偶尔死几个也没什么大不了的。
可宋元德怎么也没有想到。
宋浩这次要搞的竟然是一位筑基境！
不仅他精心培养的火云兽被宰了，就连自己都栽在了人家手里！
自己怎么就生了这么个傻逼儿子！
真特么坑爹啊。
宋元德强压下心头的惊恐，连忙陪笑道：“这位小兄弟，不好意思，刚才我一时冲动……”
然而——
宋元德话还未说到一半，叶长天抬手一挥，面前那把被他用来切肉的匕首咻地凌空而起。
宋浩一次又一次企图置他于死地。
如今他又杀了宋元德的火云鸟。

既然与这对父子仇怨已经结下，叶长天便不会手下留情！
“噗嗤！”
匕首带着一股凌厉的劲气，瞬间洞穿了宋元德的咽喉。
宋元德顿时双目圆瞪，一脸不甘地倒在了血泊中。
“爸！”
见得自己父亲就这么死在了叶长天手里，宋浩顿时面色惨白，如见鬼魅，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。
父亲可是杂役峰长老，炼气九层的修为啊。
而叶长天不过是废物一般的杂役弟子！
一个废物般的杂役弟子，竟然干掉了杂役峰长老！
这……这尼玛怎么可能？
轻描淡写地解决了宋元德，叶长天缓缓站起身来，径直朝着宋浩与张奎走了过去。
望着径直走来的叶长天。
宋浩与张奎两人身体一阵哆嗦，直接被吓得瘫软在地上，嘴里发出了一阵惊恐欲绝的尖叫：
“叶长天，你……你不能杀我们！”
“太玄宗禁止同门互相残杀，你难道要触犯太玄宗的门规不成？”
content_en:
"Ye Changtian, you fire cloud bird who dares to kill my father is dead!"
Song Hao smiled ferociously.
Fire Cloud Bird is his father's heart and soul, and his father treasures Fire Cloud Bird even more than his own son.
He wanted to see how Ye Changtian could withstand his father's anger.
Just when Song Hao was about to inform his father, a figure with a strong aura suddenly turned into an afterimage and suddenly appeared in front of Ye Changtian.
The person who came was none other than Song Hao's father, Song Yuande, the elder of the Miscellaneous Peak.
Song Yuande left a spiritual mark on Fire Cloud Bird.
The moment something happened to Fire Cloud Bird, Song Yuande naturally sensed it immediately.
Looking at the decomposed body of the Fire Cloud Bird and Ye Changtian who roasted the Fire Cloud Bird's legs until they were sizzling with oil, a monstrous killing intent instantly spread from Song Yuande's body.
"You little bastard, if you dare to touch this elder's Fire Cloud Bird, you... deserve to die!"
Song Yuande's cultivation talent was average, but he only had low-grade fire spirit roots.
He had been practicing in Taixuan Sect all his life, and finally reached the peak of the ninth level of Qi refining. Then he was stuck at the peak of the ninth level of Qi refining for many years, and it was difficult to build a foundation.
The reason why Song Yuande cherished the Fire Cloud Bird so much was because the Fire Cloud Bird's inner elixir played a vital role in his breakthrough in foundation building.
If he uses the Fire Cloud Bird Inner Pill together with the Foundation Establishment Pill, his probability of success in foundation establishment will definitely increase by ten times!
Song Yuande originally planned to raise the Fire Cloud Bird to the ninth level of Qi Refining before attacking the Foundation Establishment Realm.
That's when.
Only when he swallows the inner elixir of the Fire Cloud Bird can it exert its greatest effect.
But I didn't expect it.
The boy in front of him actually killed the Fire Cloud Bird that he had worked so hard to cultivate!
How could Song Yuande not be angry?
Facing Song Yuande who had overwhelming murderous intent, Ye Changtian's expression did not change at all.
He calmly picked up the roasted bird leg and took a bite, then grinned at Song Yuande:
"Elder Song, the Fire Cloud Bird went crazy when I came to feed it. I accidentally killed it when I was defending myself. You wouldn't mind, right?"
"The meat of this fire cloud bird is good, do you want to try it together?"
Song Yuande's face was ashen.
This kid not only killed the Fire Cloud Bird, but also roasted the Fire Cloud Bird in front of him!
I simply didn’t take him as the handyman peak elder seriously.
"Song Hao, what on earth is going on?"
Song Yuande suppressed the murderous intention in his heart and couldn't help but look at Song Hao behind him.
"Dad, Ye Changtian is the handyman disciple who came to feed the Fire Cloud Bird today. I didn't expect that he actually killed your Fire Cloud Bird!"
Song Hao quickly explained the matter with added detail.
"..."
Hearing Song Hao's words, Song Yuande even wondered if there was something wrong with his ears!
This guy who killed the Fire Cloud Bird was actually a handyman disciple who came to feed the Fire Cloud Bird?
To know.
His Fire Cloud Bird has the strength of the seventh level of Qi refining.
As for the handyman disciples at Zaoyu Peak, they are all useless people who have not reached the third level of Qi Refining. How could they possibly kill Fire Cloud Bird?
Could it be——
Did this kid poison the Fire Cloud Bird?
Who gave him the courage?
No matter what.
If this kid kills Fire Cloud Bird, it will be equivalent to ending his cultivation path.
This kind of hatred is simply more irreconcilable than the hatred of killing his father!
"Boy, I don't care who you are, if you hand over the Fire Cloud Bird inner elixir, I can consider keeping your whole body!"
Song Yuande stared at Ye Changtian with cold eyes and spoke word by word.
The Fire Cloud Bird inner elixir at the seventh level of Qi refining was not as helpful as the Fire Cloud Bird inner elixir at the ninth level of Qi refining for him to break through to the foundation building realm, but it was still better than nothing.
"What Fire Cloud Bird inner elixir, I didn't see it."
Ye Changtian gnawed on the bird leg with relish and said vaguely.
"Seeking death!"
Song Yuande shouted angrily and appeared in front of Ye Changtian in a flash. His palms were as fast as lightning and he grabbed Ye Changtian's throat.
Ye Changtian holds the bird leg in his right hand and the left handReach out unhurriedly.
Two fingers clamped Song Yuande's palm impartially, as lightly as clamping a leaf.
"You..."
Song Yuande's expression instantly became horrified.
He is at the peak of the ninth level of Qi refining, and is only one step away from breaking through the foundation building.
But the boy in front of him simply stretched out two fingers and imprisoned him, making it difficult for him to move at all.
Foundation building realm!
It is definitely a foundation-building realm cultivation!
This moment.
Only then did Song Yuande realize that Ye Changtian did not poison his Fire Cloud Bird at all, but actually had the strength to kill the Fire Cloud Bird.
"grass!"
"Isn't this guy a handyman disciple from the handyman peak? How can he have the cultivation level of the foundation building realm?"
Song Yuande was shocked and angry.
He was already thinking about killing Song Hao at this moment.
Based on his understanding of Song Hao, there is a high probability that Ye Changtian must have offended Song Hao, so he was arranged by Song Hao to feed the crazy Fire Cloud Bird and use the Fire Cloud Bird to deal with Ye Changtian.
Song Hao has used this method more than once.
Song Yuande has always turned a blind eye to this matter.
These handyman disciples become the blood food of the Fire Cloud Bird, and they can also train the Fire Cloud Bird to the ninth level of Qi Refining more quickly.
What's more -
The handyman disciples were no different from slaves in Taixuan Sect, and it was no big deal if a few died occasionally.
But Song Yuande never thought of it.
What Song Hao wants to do this time is actually a Foundation Establishment Realm!
Not only was the Fire Cloud Beast that he carefully cultivated was slaughtered, but he himself fell into the hands of others!
Why did I give birth to such an idiot son!
What a cheat.
Song Yuande suppressed the panic in his heart and quickly smiled and said: "Little brother, I'm sorry, I was impulsive just now..."
However——
Before Song Yuande had finished speaking, Ye Changtian raised his hand and waved, and the dagger he used to cut meat flew into the air.
Song Hao tried to kill him again and again.
Now he killed Song Yuande's Fire Cloud Bird again.
Now that the hatred between father and son has been forged, Ye Changtian will not show mercy!
"Pfft!"
The dagger carried a fierce force and instantly pierced Song Yuande's throat.
Song Yuande's eyes suddenly widened, and he fell into a pool of blood with a look of reluctance.
"Dad!"
Seeing his father die in Ye Changtian's hands, Song Hao suddenly turned pale, as if he had seen a ghost, and couldn't believe his eyes.
My father is an elder of the Miscellaneous Peak, with a level of cultivation at the ninth level of Qi Refining.
And Ye Changtian is just a useless handyman disciple!
A useless handyman disciple actually killed the handyman peak elder!
How is this... how is this possible?
After dealing with Song Yuande lightly, Ye Changtian slowly stood up and walked straight towards Song Hao and Zhang Kui.
Looking at Ye Changtian who was walking straight towards him.
Song Hao and Zhang Kui trembled for a while, and were so frightened that they collapsed on the ground, and screamed in horror:
"Ye Changtian, you...you can't kill us!"
"Tai Xuan Zong prohibits fellow disciples from killing each other. Are you going to violate Tai Xuan Zong's rules?"
